releaseNotes:
• Large 2:3 portrait movie posters with full cover art filling the card
• Language and category prefixes cleanly stripped from movie titles (e.g. Adinaasam Vellapokkam - 2025)
• Dedicated Movie Player OSD dock with interactive seek bar and timeline scrubber
• ±10s fast forward and rewind controls with on-screen HUD (no accidental movie jumping)
• Smooth D-Pad remote control seeking and play/pause controls
